draft.title: Solving one-step equations
card: An equation says two sides are equal. To solve it, find the value of the letter that makes it true.
Undo the operation with its inverse. Addition and subtraction undo each other. Multiplication and division undo each other.
Do the same thing to both sides, so the equation stays balanced.
Example: x + 7 = 12. Subtract 7 from both sides to get x = 5. Example: 4x = 28. Divide both sides by 4 to get x = 7.
draft.remember: Use the inverse operation on both sides to get the letter alone.

a.q: What is the first step to solve n − 9 = 15?
a.why: The equation subtracts 9 from n, so the inverse is to add 9 to both sides. This gives n = 24. Subtracting 9 again would make the left side n − 18, not n.

b.q: Priya shares her stickers equally among 6 friends, and each friend gets 8. The equation is s ÷ 6 = 8. How many stickers does Priya have?
b.why: Division is undone by multiplying both sides by 6, so s = 8 × 6 = 48. Adding 6 to 8 to get 14 uses the wrong inverse operation.
b.clue: Undo the dividing by 6 on both sides.
